description: Two UX polish items for the Cardio feature: (1) add a consistent pinned header to CardioScreen matching Settings/FoodDiary style; (2) surface weekly cardio total on the main dashboard Balance view between the insight card and history section.

userStories.title: Cardio screen consistent header
userStories.description: As a user, I want the Cardio tab to have a header like other screens so the app feels cohesive.
acceptanceCriteria: Header pinned at top of CardioScreen (outside scroll area) with title 'Cardio' (headlineMedium or displayMedium) and subtitle 'Weekly Training Log' (labelSmall, MiOrange color)
Header uses statusBarsPadding() + background(MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surface) + horizontal padding 24.dp — same pattern as MacroProfilesSettings header
WeeklySummaryCard and session list scroll beneath the pinned header — header does not scroll away

userStories.title: Weekly cardio total on main dashboard
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see my weekly cardio total on the main dashboard so I don't need to switch tabs to check it.
acceptanceCriteria: New private CardioSummaryRow composable in DashboardScreen.kt; rendered in DashboardContent between SlidingWindowInsightCard and the History section header

Row shows: Icons.AutoMirrored.Filled.DirectionsRun icon (MiOrange, 20.dp), label 'Cardio this week' (bodyMedium, MiTextSecondary), value right-aligned e.g. '120 min' (bodyLarge, onSurface); shows '0 min' when no sessions
DashboardContent gains a new weeklyCardioMinutes: Int = 0 parameter; existing call sites compile unchanged
CardioSummaryRow only rendered when viewMode == DashboardViewMode.BALANCE (hidden for INTAKE and EXPENDITURE)
Same horizontal padding (24.dp) as surrounding content
